description: PostgreSQL 18 user-type ACL defaults, comments, schema movement, dependency catalogs, and DROP behavior
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_managed_rows CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_target.managed_state CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_target.score_range CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_source.managed_state CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_source.score_range CASCADE;
sql: CREATE ROLE type_matrix_type_reader;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS type_matrix_source;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS type_matrix_target;
CREATE TYPE type_matrix_source.managed_state AS ENUM ('open', 'closed');
SELECT typacl IS NULL AS default_acl_is_null, has_type_privilege('type_matrix_type_reader', 'type_matrix_source.managed_state', 'USAGE') AS public_usage FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'managed_state';
REVOKE USAGE ON TYPE type_matrix_source.managed_state FROM PUBLIC;

SELECT typacl IS NOT NULL AS acl_materialized, has_type_privilege('type_matrix_type_reader', 'type_matrix_source.managed_state', 'USAGE') AS usage_revoked FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'managed_state';
GRANT USAGE ON TYPE type_matrix_source.managed_state TO type_matrix_type_reader;
SELECT has_type_privilege('type_matrix_type_reader', oid, 'USAGE') AS oid_usage_granted FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'managed_state';
COMMENT ON TYPE type_matrix_source.managed_state IS 'managed workflow state';
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_managed_rows (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, state type_matrix_source.managed_state);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_managed_rows VALUES (1, 'open');
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_source.managed_state SET SCHEMA type_matrix_target;

SELECT value.state, pg_typeof(value.state)::text AS moved_type, obj_description(type_catalog.oid, 'pg_type') AS comment FROM type_matrix_managed_rows AS value JOIN pg_type AS type_catalog ON type_catalog.typname = 'managed_state';
SELECT description FROM pg_description WHERE objoid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'managed_state');
SELECT count(*) >= 2 AS dependencies_visible FROM pg_depend WHERE refclassid = 1247 AND refobjid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'managed_state');
CREATE TYPE type_matrix_source.score_range AS RANGE (SUBTYPE = int4);
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_source.score_range SET SCHEMA type_matrix_target;

SELECT range_namespace.nspname AS range_schema, multirange_namespace.nspname AS multirange_schema FROM pg_range AS range_catalog JOIN pg_type AS range_type ON range_type.oid = range_catalog.rngtypid JOIN pg_namespace AS range_namespace ON range_namespace.oid = range_type.typnamespace JOIN pg_type AS multirange_type ON multirange_type.oid = range_catalog.rngmultitypid JOIN pg_namespace AS multirange_namespace ON multirange_namespace.oid = multirange_type.typnamespace WHERE range_type.typname = 'score_range';
DROP TYPE type_matrix_target.managed_state CASCADE;
SELECT count(*) AS remaining_managed_types FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'managed_state';
DROP TYPE type_matrix_target.score_range CASCADE;
DROP ROLE type_matrix_type_reader;
